sentences.en: The children were doing a project on the Olympic Games.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们是做一个项目在……上这奥林匹克运动会的游戏。

sentences.en: "Tomorrow we will go to the museum and next week it's sports day," said Mrs May.
"Everyone can enter a race on sports day," said Mrs May.
sentences.zh: 每个人能进来一个速度竞赛在……上运动一天， 说太太梅。

sentences.en: I think the girls should have a sewing race, laughed one of the boys.
sentences.zh: 我想这女孩应该有一个缝纫速度竞赛！ 笑一的这男孩。

sentences.en: After school, Anneena and Wilma went to play with Biff.
sentences.zh: 在……之后学校， Anneena 和 Wilma 去到玩和……一起 Biff。

sentences.en: Anneena was cross.
sentences.zh: Anneena 是叉形。

sentences.en: "Some boys are so silly," she said.
sentences.zh: 一些男孩是所以傻的， 她说。

sentences.en: The magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 魔法钥匙开始发光。

sentences.en: The magic took the girls back in time, to a village in Greece.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿这女孩回来在……里时间， 到一个村庄在……里希腊。

sentences.en: A boy was calling to the villagers, "Follow me to the games," He said.
sentences.zh: 一个男孩是叫到这村民。 他说。

sentences.en: "Can we go too?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 能我们去也？ 问 Biff。 Biff 问道。

sentences.en: "Anyone can come!"
sentences.zh: 任何人能来！ 说这男孩。

sentences.en: Said the boy, "as long as they are male."
sentences.zh: 像长的像他们是雄性的。

sentences.en: The men and the boys from the village went to the games. Said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 这男人们和这男孩从这村庄去到这游戏。 阿尼娜说。

sentences.en: "Let's follow them," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 让我们跟随他们， 说 Biff。 Biff 说道。

sentences.en: They only let men and boys into the games, "We'll never get in," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 他们只有让男人们和男孩在……里到这游戏。 Biff 说道。

sentences.en: Outside the games, there were lots of guards.
sentences.zh: 外面这游戏， 那里是许多的警卫。

sentences.en: "I wish we could see!" Said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们能看见！ 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: Anneena had an idea.
sentences.zh: Anneena 有一个主意。

sentences.en: "Let's climb a tree," she said.
sentences.zh: 让我们爬一个树， 她说。

sentences.en: The girls climbed an olive tree.
sentences.zh: 这女孩爬一个油橄榄树。

sentences.en: They could see the games.
sentences.zh: 他们能看见这游戏。

sentences.en: They watched a race.
sentences.zh: 他们手表一个速度竞赛。

sentences.en: Lots of men ran with shields.
sentences.zh: 许多的男人们跑和……一起盾牌。

sentences.en: The winner won a prize.
sentences.zh: 这获胜者赢一个奖品。

sentences.en: The prize was a vase.
sentences.zh: 这奖品是一个花瓶。

sentences.en: A man put a crown on the winner's head.
sentences.zh: 一个男人放一个王冠在……上这获胜者头。

sentences.en: Then the girls watched some men throwing discs as far as they could.
sentences.zh: 然后这女孩手表一些男人们扔圆盘像远像他们能。

sentences.en: "Hey you!" Shouted a girl.
sentences.zh: “嘿！” 嗨你！ 喊一个女孩。

sentences.en: The girl was under the tree.
sentences.zh: 这女孩是在……下方这树。

sentences.en: "If anyone catches you here, you'll be in for the high jump!" She said.
sentences.zh: 如果任何人抓住你这里， 你会是在……里为了这高的跳！ 她说。

sentences.en: Asked Biff. "I'm picking olives," Said the girl.
sentences.zh: Biff 问道。 我是挑选油橄榄， 说这女孩。

sentences.en: "Then, why are you here?"
sentences.zh: 然后， 为什么是你这里？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: "My name is Hera.
sentences.zh: 我的名字是 Hera。

sentences.en: You'd better come with me to the village." Said Mila.
sentences.zh: You'd 更好的来和……一起我到这村庄。 Wilma 说道。

sentences.en: In the village, they met Hera's friend, Mila.
sentences.zh: 在……里这村庄， 他们遇见 Hera's 朋友， Mila。

sentences.en: "It's always quiet when the games are on," said Mila.
sentences.zh: 它是总是安静的当……时这游戏是在……上， 说 Mila。

sentences.en: "It's so boring!"
sentences.zh: 它是所以令人厌倦的！

sentences.en: Suddenly, Anneena had an idea.
sentences.zh: 突然地， Anneena 有一个主意。

sentences.en: "Can you get all of your friends together?" She asked.
sentences.zh: 能你得到全部的你的朋友们一起？ 她问。 她问道。

sentences.en: The girls in the village came to the meeting.
sentences.zh: 这女孩在……里这村庄来到这遇见。

sentences.en: "This is my grandmother," said Mila.
sentences.zh: 这个是我的外婆， 说 Mila。 Wilma 说道。

sentences.en: "She paints the vases for the games."
sentences.zh: 她油漆这花瓶为了这游戏。

sentences.en: "Listen, everyone," "Why should boys have all the fun?
sentences.zh: 听每个人， 说 Anneena。

sentences.en: Let's have a girls' Olympic Games!"
sentences.zh: 让我们有一个女孩' 奥林匹克运动会的游戏！

sentences.en: There were all sorts of races and all the girls took part.
sentences.zh: 那里是全部种类的速度竞赛和全部这女孩拿部分。

sentences.en: There was a three-legged race and a sack race.
sentences.zh: 那里是一个三条腿的速度竞赛和一个大口袋速度竞赛。

sentences.en: Mila's grandmother gave the girls some old plates.
sentences.zh: Mila's 外婆给这女孩一些旧的盘子。

sentences.en: The girls threw them like disks.
sentences.zh: 这女孩扔他们喜欢圆盘。

sentences.en: They threw them as far as they could.
sentences.zh: 他们扔他们像远像他们能。

sentences.en: The girls had an olive-and-spoon race.
sentences.zh: 这女孩有一个 olive-and-spoon 速度竞赛。

sentences.en: Biff dropped her olives and Hera slipped on them!
sentences.zh: Biff 掉下她油橄榄和 Hera 滑倒在……上他们！

sentences.en: Mila's grandmother painted the girls on a vase.
sentences.zh: Mila's 外婆油漆这女孩在……上一个花瓶。

sentences.en: Hera made some crowns from olive twigs.
sentences.zh: Hera 做一些王冠从油橄榄细枝。

sentences.en: "We're all winners!" She said.
sentences.zh: 我们是全部获胜者！ 她说。

sentences.en: The boys and the men came back.
sentences.zh: 这男孩和这男人们来回来。

sentences.en: "Girls doing sports?" Said one boy.
sentences.zh: 女孩做运动？ 说一男孩。

sentences.en: "That will never catch on!"
sentences.zh: 那个将从不抓住在……上！

sentences.en: Suddenly, the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然，魔法钥匙开始发光。

sentences.en: The next day, Mrs. May took the class to the museum.
sentences.zh: 他把这事告诉了

sentences.en: There was a display about the Greek Olympics.
sentences.zh: 那里是一个陈列品关于这希腊的奥林匹克运动会的。

sentences.en: In a glass case there was a broken vase.
sentences.zh: 在……里一个玻璃箱子那里是一个打破花瓶。

sentences.en: "A long time ago, a girls' Olympics began," Said Mrs. May.
sentences.zh: 一个长的时间以前， 一个女孩' 奥林匹克运动会的开始， 说太太梅。 老师说道。

sentences.en: Mila looked at the boys, "And did the idea catch on?" She asked.
sentences.zh: 和做这主意抓住在……上？ 她问。 她问道。
